description: This file sets up a GStreamer video test source and integrates it into a pipeline with transport mechanisms for a bot, primarily used in a testing or demonstration context for a pipeline-based application.

classes.name: GStreamerPipelineSource
classes.description: Represents a GStreamer pipeline source configured for a videotestsrc element.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Manages a sequence of pipeline components to process media.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a task involving a pipeline with specific parameters like timeout.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and management of pipeline tasks, including signal handling.

classes.name: OutputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the pipeline output, such as video width, height, and sync.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Sets up and runs the pipeline with GStreamer test source and transport.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes transport and runs the pipeline.
